integrity: Analytical argument and deterministic numerical verifier included. Historical completeness and publication priority are not certified. No independent audit has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Complete graphs divided into exactly two vertex groups of sizes at least two; independent nonnegative conductances; within-group constant positive prices and unit cross-group price; linear total budget; weighted spanning-tree determinant, not effective-resistance sum. No claim for arbitrary prices per edge, omitted cross edges, degree constraints, capacity bounds, or discrete design counts. Numerical tests are finite and do not substitute for the proof.
title: Four support regimes in price-constrained D-optimal two-community complete networks
